comment: C-first source probe for pray.c:pleased -> give_spell. Move off the stair, wish a luckstone and neutral altar, offer a lawful white unicorn for the +5 alignment change, and offer two red dragon corpses for Luck. Each heavy-corpse wish has a space to dismiss its Oops page; each sacrifice confirmation is y followed by two spaces for the source messages/pagers. The prayer confirmation is followed by y, two pager dismissals, then three wait turns. This preserves the earlier input-shape failures and records the actual C branch.
